gaps.criterion_why: Each acceptance part the leaf names needs a scene arm that reads it.

But the scene's expect has no gunfire arm, and its control is 'the same Unfinished held by a wall one cell outside the ring'. Only a Repulsor Burn is used, although the capability says 'Any active Burn'.

gaps.what: Coalescence payoff: no scene kills a Coalescence by gunfire, and none collapses one in a natural Burn
gaps.would_pass: sc_coalescence_grows_and_breaks (or a new scene) expects: the second Coalescence, destroyed by gunfire, leaves less mulch than the Burn-collapsed one and zero Monstrous samples; and one Coalescence collapses in a natural Burn with samples.

gaps.criterion_why: A cap is exercised only when it is reached.
gaps.observed: Both scenes only expect 'within the cap'. Neither raises emission to the 'map-wide count cap', so a missing cap passes trivially.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: add a cap-saturation arm to sc_waiting_costs_more

gaps.would_pass: A scene arm runs emission until the count reaches the cap (for example a stage-3 Coalescence held long) and reads that the count equals the cap and stays there for N emissions.

reasons: Showcases, unit coverage and flagship binding hold (every built or approved inventory unit is in a showcase or coverage_rest; showcase 1 burn_dash is bound to d_q02_first_demo). But 25 gaps remain, and every one can be fixed at stage 3. Measured against source: no Repulsor warning exists in CompCloudRepulsor.cs, and RM_ContagionTouched.cs has no active-change transition message, yet neither scene names an owed build. Scene expectations are also weaker than their leaves' oracles: sc_cast_lives_here accepts "at least half the rows spawn", sc_coalescence_grows_and_breaks drops the gunfire arm, and sc_waiting_costs_more reads recovery workers it never stages. The sheet claims a Monstrous-limb check that no scene runs. Several built parts have no scene or check at all: the manhunter cap, the inject eligibility and Monstrous-first rules, the non-donor mismatch control, gawpsack rise and its reset after load, four of the seven open fix items, and the Bulloo meat and leather. legacy_placement_worker's coverage_rest is a label check, not the absence check the contract requires.
